newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC share market closes stable.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC share market closes stable.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market ended mixed on Monday with most shares closing flat or slightly up, traders said.
"The market was stable with only marginal moves," one trader said. He expected the market to remain steady on Tuesday with some blue chips attracting most attention.
Gainers outnumbered losers by 236 to 121. Prices for 250 stocks were unchanged.
Two independent indices computed by brokerage houses, based on average prices and market capitalisation, inched up from the previous session. A third index drifted down.
The VAB-RA all-share index rose by 1.3 percent to 6,576.4 points and BIG-OTC gained 0.57 percent to 4,738.75 points. The CAS-RQ slipped 0.12 percent to 1,025 points.

Among the gainers was the cement maker Moldocim, which closed 1,000 lei firmer to 44,000, while Romcim, another cement maker, closed flat at 115,000, though traders said that some deals were clinched at around 120,000 lei.
Refineries lost some ground, when prices for most were subject to corrections after rises throughout last week.
Petromidia went down 3,500 lei to 41,500, while Arpechim sank 3,000 lei to 38,000. Petrobrazi, another refinery, closed 1,000 lei higher at 42,000.

Wire maker Ductil ended 200 lei up at 3,300 under buying pressure. Operators said more than 462 million shares in Ductil were traded. "Ductil has good economic potential and that keeps it attractive," one trader said.
Turnover stayed flat at 22.1 billion lei.
